SMTO-CFG-0040 — SMTO's settings file has no model server address

GUID: 6878cfc8-ffd7-4283-becf-0fa7c218ece9
Slug: config-llm-base-url-is-required
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: cfg

What happened

  • SMTO's startup settings file (usually config.yaml) has a base_url line for the AI model with nothing in it, so SMTO doesn't know where your model is and stopped.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open the settings file (usually config.yaml) in a plain text editor and find base_url under the llm section. That is the line SMTO found empty.
  2. Enter the model server's full address, such as http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1, or delete the line so SMTO uses that local address. SMTO needs an address starting with http:// or https:// to reach the model; without the line it uses the local default.
  3. Save the file and start SMTO again. SMTO reads this settings file only while it starts.

What success looks like

  • SMTO starts and the startup screen reaches Ready.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details (or copy the message from the window where SMTO was started) and send it to the person who manages SMTO. Don't change unrelated settings such as timeouts or limits; they won't supply the missing address.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Configuration validation failed because the effective model base URL (llm.base_url in the bootstrap YAML, or Settings.llm_base_url) is blank after trimming.

What this means

  • Effective model-provider base_url is empty after normalization. Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.

Why this can happen

  • Effective model-provider base_url is empty after normalization.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect llm.base_url or its effective setting source before testing connectivity.

How to fix it

  • Set llm.base_url in the bootstrap YAML to the intended OpenAI-compatible endpoint (http or https with a host), or remove the key to use the default http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1; Settings applies the same check to llm_base_url. The value must then also pass endpoint parsing and a separate reachability check.
  • Configure the intended supported model endpoint in llm.base_url.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended nonempty endpoint also passes URL and provider checks.

What not to do

  • Do not change an unrelated timeout, budget or policy. Check whether the named setting applies only to a new task.

Technical notes

  • Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.
